approval_note: all: every Short waits for Charlie's OK; flagged: only Shorts with a reason to look wait (the end goal); none: everything uploads straight away.
note: Uploads are capped by YouTube's channel limit: 10 in any 24 hours until the channel has Advanced features (video selfie). The YouTube Data API default quota is no constraint: 100 uploads a day in their own bucket plus 10,000 units for other calls, reset at midnight Pacific time (developers.google.com/youtube/v3/determine_quota_cost). After Advanced features: daily_limit and per_session 20, slot_first 08:00, slot_every_minutes 45, slots_per_day 20, and a second writer run at 12:50.
tiktok_note: manual: Charlie uploads the day's 5 TikTok picks himself in TikTok Studio on desktop (files and captions come in the morning message); inbox: drafts to the TikTok phone app; direct: posts by itself (needs TikTok's review).
